title: Keep model affinity inside a coherent work loop
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Within one coherent loop, Nubble wants routing to prefer the already-chosen lane unless a phase boundary justifies a switch. Random lane thrash must not win on unit price alone. He walks product steps (check_model_affinity) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario.
implementation: `route_at_boundary` and `activate_scoped_policy` in `mechaharness.routing` keep affinity inside a coherent work loop; uncalibrated policies do not activate. `CliInstrumentor` verb `check_model_affinity` exposes the diagnostic.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `affinity_lane.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
